rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about the Newspaper Advertisement of post-dispatch of Annual Report for Financial year 2025-2026.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on September 28, 2026

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper Advertisement for Pre-dispatch of Annual Report.

rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr M/s V C Shah & Co as the Internal Auditor of the company w.e.f. August 19, 2026.

rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of M/s AP Sanzgiri & Co as a Statutory Auditor of the company w.e.f. September 29, 2026.

rows.title: Amalgamation/Merger
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about the  Approval of scheme of arrangement for the merger of EMA Partners Executive Search Private Limited(Transferor Company No 1), Emagine People Technologies Private Limited (Transferor Company No2) and EMA Decision Dynamics Private Limited (Transferor Company No 3) with the Company viz., EMA Partners India Limited, (Transferee Company).

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Approval of  scheme of arrangement for the merger of EMA Partners Executive Search Private Limited(Transferor Company No 1), Emagine People Technologies Private Limited (Transferor Company No2) and EMA Decision Dynamics Private Limited (Transferor Company No 3) with the Company viz., EMA Partners India Limited, (Transferee Company) in the outcome of Board Meeting held on August 19, 2026.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Re- Appointment of Statutory Auditor and Appointment of Internal Auditor in Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 19, 2026.

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about the updated Investor Presentation of the Company, incorporating information regarding the recent acquisition by the Company. The same is being disseminated for the information of the stakeholders.

rows.title: Investor Presentation
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has sent letters, inter alia, providing the web-link to access the Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025-26, including the Notice of the 23rd Annual General Meeting, to those Members whose e-mail addresses are not registered with the Company/Registrar and Transfer Agent/Depository Participant(s).
